correctness.rationale: The line-graph identity and induced-P3 characterization prove the exact star-forest bijection. Adding a missing edge proves the complete three-case maximality test, including one-row and nonfull-support cases. The two-sort labeled exponential formula correctly subtracts one-edge stars counted twice. The two correction terms use restricted set partitions with strict incomplete-support bounds. The component count proves the complete size support, and exact graph enumeration agrees in twelve cases and 221 larger support pairs; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Minimal cluster vertex deletion is a standard graph problem, and rook graphs are canonical complete-graph Cartesian products. This result gives the full cardinality distribution of every minimal deletion set, a closed labeled coefficient formula, exact supports and explicit unbounded gaps in connected prisms. For shores at least three it also counts all minimum deletion sets exactly, which is not an arbitrary slice or merely a small numerical instance.
